mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are a comfortable 66 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park and a beautiful full moon. Please note the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City officials have announced that a section of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final pavement work. Drivers are encouraged to follow posted detours along Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today you can catch live music at Bailey's Run or at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out Yoga at Insight Wellness, and keep an eye out for trivia and market events starting on September 29.
Looking at the weekly police report, on September 5, officers investigated a series of incidents where vehicles were found with cheese on their windshields, a trend known as the Dairy Dare.
It is a great day to visit Culver's as they are currently open until 10 PM. Stop by to enjoy today's delicious Flavor of the Day, which is Turtle.
